question: Which team had more home victories in the 2021 season's matches of the Bundesliga division, Augsburg or Mainz?

query: SELECT T2.PLAYER_NAME FROM SOCCER_2016.SEASON  T1 INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.PLAYER  T2 ON T1.MAN_OF_THE_SERIES = T2.PLAYER_ID WHERE T1.MAN_OF_THE_SERIES > 1
SQL: SELECT T2.PLAYER_NAME FROM SOCCER_2016.SEASON  T1 INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.PLAYER  T2 ON T1.MAN_OF_THE_SERIES = T2.PLAYER_ID WHERE T1.MAN_OF_THE_SERIES > 1

question: List the name and country of the players who got more than average catches in ascending order of the number of catches.

query: SELECT T1.PLAYER_NAME, T4.COUNTRY_NAME FROM SOCCER_2016.PLAYER  T1 INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.WICKET_TAKEN  T2 ON T1.PLAYER_ID = T2.FIELDERS INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.OUT_TYPE  T3 ON T2.KIND_OUT = T3.OUT_ID INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.COUNTRY  T4 ON T1.COUNTRY_NAME = T4.COUNTRY_ID GROUP BY T1.PLAYER_NAME, T4.COUNTRY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T3.OUT_NAME) ASC
SQL: SELECT T1.PLAYER_NAME, T4.COUNTRY_NAME FROM SOCCER_2016.PLAYER  T1 INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.WICKET_TAKEN  T2 ON T1.PLAYER_ID = T2.FIELDERS INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.OUT_TYPE  T3 ON T2.KIND_OUT = T3.OUT_ID INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.COUNTRY  T4 ON T1.COUNTRY_NAME = T4.COUNTRY_ID GROUP BY T1.PLAYER_NAME, T4.COUNTRY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T3.OUT_NAME) ASC

question: What is the difference in the average number of players out by lbw and runout in the matches?

question: Calculate the run rate at the end of 17 overs of the match ID 335987 on 4/18/2008.
evidence: 4/18/2008 refers to Match_Date = 4/18/2008; end of 17 overs refers to count(Toss_Name = 'field' ) = 17; run rate = divide(sum(Runs_Scored) when Toss_Name = 'bat', sum(Over_Id) when Toss_Name = 'field')
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.TOSS_NAME = 'BAT' THEN T3.RUNS_SCORED ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.TOSS_NAME = 'FIELD' THEN T3.OVER_ID END) FROM SOCCER_2016.TOSS_DECISION T1 INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.MATCH T2 ON T1.TOSS_ID = T2.TOSS_DECIDE INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.BATSMAN_SCORED T3 ON T2.MATCH_ID = T3.MATCH_ID WHERE T2.MATCH_ID = 335987 AND T2.MATCH_DATE = TO_DATE('2008-04-18', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T3.OVER_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.TOSS_NAME = 'FIELD' THEN T3.OVER_ID END) = 17
SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.TOSS_NAME = 'BAT' THEN T3.RUNS_SCORED ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.TOSS_NAME = 'FIELD' THEN T3.OVER_ID END) FROM SOCCER_2016.TOSS_DECISION T1 INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.MATCH T2 ON T1.TOSS_ID = T2.TOSS_DECIDE INNER JOIN SOCCER_2016.BATSMAN_SCORED T3 ON T2.MATCH_ID = T3.MATCH_ID WHERE T2.MATCH_ID = 335987 AND T2.MATCH_DATE = TO_DATE('2008-04-18', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T3.OVER_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.TOSS_NAME = 'FIELD' THEN T3.OVER_ID END) = 17

question: What is the difference between the units sold for item 1 when the sunset was the earliest and the latest?
evidence: item 1 refers to item_nbr = 1; when the sunset earliest refers to Min(sunset); latest sunset refers to Max(sunset); difference unit sold refers to Subtract(Sum(units where Min(sunset)), Sum(units where Max(sunset)))
query:
SELECT (
  SELECT SUM(T2.UNITS) AS SUMUNIT
  FROM  SALES_IN_WEATHER.WEATHER T1
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.SALES_IN_WEATHER T2 ON T1."DATE" = T2."DATE"
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.RELATION T3 ON T2.STORE_NBR = T3.STORE_NBR
  WHERE T2.ITEM_NBR = 5
    AND T1.SUNSET IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY T1.SUNSET
  ORDER BY T1.SUNSET
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
) - (
  SELECT SUM(T2.UNITS) AS SUMUNIT
  FROM  SALES_IN_WEATHER.WEATHER T1
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.SALES_IN_WEATHER T2 ON T1."DATE" = T2."DATE"
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.RELATION T3 ON T2.STORE_NBR = T3.STORE_NBR
  WHERE T2.ITEM_NBR = 5
    AND T1.SUNSET IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY T1.SUNSET
  ORDER BY T1.SUNSET DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
) FROM DUAL
SQL:
SELECT (
  SELECT SUM(T2.UNITS) AS SUMUNIT
  FROM  SALES_IN_WEATHER.WEATHER T1
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.SALES_IN_WEATHER T2 ON T1."DATE" = T2."DATE"
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.RELATION T3 ON T2.STORE_NBR = T3.STORE_NBR
  WHERE T2.ITEM_NBR = 5
    AND T1.SUNSET IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY T1.SUNSET
  ORDER BY T1.SUNSET
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
) - (
  SELECT SUM(T2.UNITS) AS SUMUNIT
  FROM  SALES_IN_WEATHER.WEATHER T1
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.SALES_IN_WEATHER T2 ON T1."DATE" = T2."DATE"
  INNER JOIN  SALES_IN_WEATHER.RELATION T3 ON T2.STORE_NBR = T3.STORE_NBR
  WHERE T2.ITEM_NBR = 5
    AND T1.SUNSET IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY T1.SUNSET
  ORDER BY T1.SUNSET DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
) FROM DUAL

question: Which items from store 1 have the highest units sold during rainy day?
evidence: store 1 refers to store_nbr = 1; highest unit sold refers to Max(units); during rainy day refers to codesum like '%'||'RA'||'%'; item refers to item_nbr
query:
SELECT ITEM_NBR FROM (
  SELECT T2.ITEM_NBR, SUM(T2.UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM SALES_IN_WEATHER.WEATHER T1
  INNER JOIN SALES_IN_WEATHER.SALES_IN_WEATHER T2 ON T1."DATE" = T2."DATE"
  INNER JOIN SALES_IN_WEATHER.RELATION T3 ON T2.STORE_NBR = T3.STORE_NBR AND T1.STATION_NBR = T3.STATION_NBR

  GROUP BY T2.ITEM_NBR
  ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC

SQL:

  SELECT T2.ITEM_NBR, SUM(T2.UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM SALES_IN_WEATHER.WEATHER T1
  INNER JOIN SALES_IN_WEATHER.SALES_IN_WEATHER T2 ON T1."DATE" = T2."DATE"
  INNER JOIN SALES_IN_WEATHER.RELATION T3 ON T2.STORE_NBR = T3.STORE_NBR AND T1.STATION_NBR = T3.STATION_NBR

question: What are the top 3 states with the highest Asian population? List the full names of all the representatives in the said states.
evidence: city with highest asian population refers to Max(Sum(asian_population)); full name refers to first_name, last_name
query: WITH TOP_3_STATES AS (SELECT T.STATE FROM ADDRESS.ZIP_DATA T INNER JOIN ADDRESS.CONGRESS T1 ON T.STATE = T1.ABBREVIATION GROUP BY T.STATE ORDER BY SUM(T.ASIAN_POPULATION) DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY) SELECT T.STATE, MIN(C.FIRST_NAME) as FIRST_NAME, MIN(C.LAST_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY C.FIRST_NAME) as LAST_NAME FROM TOP_3_STATES T JOIN ADDRESS.CONGRESS C ON T.STATE = C.ABBREVIATION GROUP BY T.STATE ORDER BY T.STATE
SQL: WITH TOP_3_STATES AS (SELECT T.STATE FROM ADDRESS.ZIP_DATA T INNER JOIN ADDRESS.CONGRESS T1 ON T.STATE = T1.ABBREVIATION GROUP BY T.STATE ORDER BY SUM(T.ASIAN_POPULATION) DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY) SELECT T.STATE, MIN(C.FIRST_NAME) as FIRST_NAME, MIN(C.LAST_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY C.FIRST_NAME) as LAST_NAME FROM TOP_3_STATES T JOIN ADDRESS.CONGRESS C ON T.STATE = C.ABBREVIATION GROUP BY T.STATE ORDER BY T.STATE

query: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'P.O. BOX ONLY' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'POST OFFICE' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)  DIFFERENCE FROM ADDRESS.AREA_CODE  T1 INNER JOIN ADDRESS.ZIP_DATA  T2 ON T1.ZIP_CODE = T2.ZIP_CODE WHERE T1.AREA_CODE = 787
SQL: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'P.O. BOX ONLY' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'POST OFFICE' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)  DIFFERENCE FROM ADDRESS.AREA_CODE  T1 INNER JOIN ADDRESS.ZIP_DATA  T2 ON T1.ZIP_CODE = T2.ZIP_CODE WHERE T1.AREA_CODE = 787

question: Compare the numbers of postal points under Smith Adrian and Heck Joe.
evidence: COUNT(zip_code where first_name = 'Smith' and last_name = 'Adrian') > COUNT(zip_code where first_name = 'Heck' and last_name = 'Joe');

SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.FIRST_NAME = 'SMITH' AND T1.LAST_NAME = 'ADRIAN' THEN T2.ZIP_CODE ELSE NULL END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.FIRST_NAME = 'HECK' AND T1.LAST_NAME = 'JOE' THEN T2.ZIP_CODE ELSE NULL END) THEN 'SMITH ADRIAN>HECK JOE' ELSE 'SMITH ADRIAN<=HECK JOE' END  COMPARE FROM ADDRESS.CONGRESS  T1 INNER JOIN ADDRESS.ZIP_CONGRESS  T2 ON T1.COGNRESS_REP_ID = T2.DISTRICT

query: SELECT T3.ELEVATION FROM ADDRESS.STATE  T1 INNER JOIN ADDRESS.COUNTRY  T2 ON T1.ABBREVIATION = T2.STATE INNER JOIN ADDRESS.ZIP_DATA  T3 ON T2.ZIP_CODE = T3.ZIP_CODE WHERE T1.NAME = 'Massachusetts' AND T2.COUNTY = 'HAMPDEN' GROUP BY T3.ELEVATION

question: In 1994 which title had less order quanty than the average order quantity? Find the title name, type and price.

query: SELECT T1.TITLE FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.TITLES T1 INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.SALES T2 ON T1.TITLE_ID = T2.TITLE_ID INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.PUBLISHERS T3 ON T1.PUB_ID = T3.PUB_ID WHERE T2.QTY > (SELECT CAST(SUM(QTY) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT TITLE_ID) FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.SALES) AND T3.STATE = 'CA' GROUP BY T1.TITLE ORDER BY SUM(T2.QTY) DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SQL: SELECT T1.TITLE FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.TITLES T1 INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.SALES T2 ON T1.TITLE_ID = T2.TITLE_ID INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.PUBLISHERS T3 ON T1.PUB_ID = T3.PUB_ID WHERE T2.QTY > (SELECT CAST(SUM(QTY) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT TITLE_ID) FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.SALES) AND T3.STATE = 'CA' GROUP BY T1.TITLE ORDER BY SUM(T2.QTY) DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

question: For the quantities, what percent more did the store in Fremont sell than the store in Portland in 1993?
evidence:
qty is abbreviation for quantity; Fremont and Portland are name of city; sell in 1993 refers to YEAR(ord_date) = 1993; percentage = DIVIDE(
SUBTRACT(SUM(qty where city = ‘Fremont’ and year(ord_date = 1993)), 
SUM(qty where city = ‘Portland’ and year(ord_date = 1993))), SUM(qty where city = ‘Fremont’ and year(ord_date = 1993)) *100
query: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CITY = 'Fremont' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CITY = 'Portland' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CITY = 'Fremont' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.SALES T1 INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.STORES T2 ON T1.STOR_ID = T2.STOR_ID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.ORD_DATE) = 1993
SQL: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CITY = 'Fremont' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CITY = 'Portland' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CITY = 'Fremont' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.SALES T1 INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.STORES T2 ON T1.STOR_ID = T2.STOR_ID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.ORD_DATE) = 1993

question: Find the difference between the average royalty of titles published by US and non US publishers?
evidence: US publisher refers publisher in the US where country = 'USA'; non-US publishers refers publisher not in the US where country! = 'USA'; difference = SUBTRACT(AVG(royalty) where country = 'USA', AVG(royalty) where country! = 'USA'))
query: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY = 'USA' THEN T1.ROYALTY ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY != 'USA' THEN T1.ROYALTY ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY != 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.TITLES T1 INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.PUBLISHERS T2 ON T1.PUB_ID = T2.PUB_ID INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.ROYSCHED T3 ON T1.TITLE_ID = T3.TITLE_ID
SQL: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY = 'USA' THEN T1.ROYALTY ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY != 'USA' THEN T1.ROYALTY ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.COUNTRY != 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.TITLES T1 INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.PUBLISHERS T2 ON T1.PUB_ID = T2.PUB_ID INNER JOIN BOOK_PUBLISHING_COMPANY.ROYSCHED T3 ON T1.TITLE_ID = T3.TITLE_ID

question: Which cohort had the higher percentage of students who graduated from Central Alabama Community College in 2011 within 150 percent of normal/expected time, female White students or male White students?
evidence: amount of percentage = SUM(grad_150 WHERE gender = 'F') as female; percentage = SUM(grad_150 WHERE gender = 'M') as male; Central Alabama Community College refers to chronname = 'Central Alabama Community College'; in 2011 refers to year = 2011; graduated within 150 percent of normal/expected time refers to grad_150; female refers to gender = 'F'; White refers to race = 'w'; male refers to gender = 'M';
query:
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T2.GENDER = 'F' THEN TO_NUMBER(T2.GRAD_150) ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T2.GENDER = 'M' THEN TO_NUMBER(T2.GRAD_150) ELSE 0 END) THEN 'FEMALE WHITE STUDENTS' ELSE 'MALE WHITE STUDENTS' END AS RESULT

WHERE T1.CHRONNAME = 'Central Alabama Community College'
  AND T2.YEAR = 2011
  AND T2.RACE = 'W'

question: What is the percentage of winning rate of improvement since Alain Vigneault became the coach of Vancouver Canucks in 2006 season?
evidence:
winning rate refers to DIVIDE (w, SUM(w, l)); Vancouver Canucks is name of team where tmID = 'VAN'
Winning rate refers to DIVIDE(wins in year = '2005/2006'(ADD(wins+loses); improvement refers to SUBTRACT(DIVIDE(wins in year = '2005'(ADD(wins+loses), DIVIDE(wins in year = '2006'(ADD(wins+loses))
query: WITH WIN_RATE_2006 AS (SELECT CAST(T1.W AS FLOAT) * 100 / (T1.W + T1.L) AS RATE_2006 FROM HOCKEY.TEAMS T1 INNER JOIN HOCKEY.COACHES T2 ON T1.TMID = T2.TMID AND T1.YEAR = T2.YEAR INNER JOIN HOCKEY.MASTER T3 ON T2.COACHID = T3.COACHID WHERE T1.NAME = 'Vancouver Canucks' AND T3.FIRSTNAME = 'Alain' AND T3.LASTNAME = 'Vigneault' AND T1.YEAR = 2006), WIN_RATE_2005 AS (SELECT CAST(W AS FLOAT) * 100 / (W + L) AS RATE_2005 FROM HOCKEY.TEAMS WHERE YEAR = 2005 AND NAME = 'Vancouver Canucks') SELECT RATE_2006 - RATE_2005 FROM WIN_RATE_2006, WIN_RATE_2005
SQL: WITH WIN_RATE_2006 AS (SELECT CAST(T1.W AS FLOAT) * 100 / (T1.W + T1.L) AS RATE_2006 FROM HOCKEY.TEAMS T1 INNER JOIN HOCKEY.COACHES T2 ON T1.TMID = T2.TMID AND T1.YEAR = T2.YEAR INNER JOIN HOCKEY.MASTER T3 ON T2.COACHID = T3.COACHID WHERE T1.NAME = 'Vancouver Canucks' AND T3.FIRSTNAME = 'Alain' AND T3.LASTNAME = 'Vigneault' AND T1.YEAR = 2006), WIN_RATE_2005 AS (SELECT CAST(W AS FLOAT) * 100 / (W + L) AS RATE_2005 FROM HOCKEY.TEAMS WHERE YEAR = 2005 AND NAME = 'Vancouver Canucks') SELECT RATE_2006 - RATE_2005 FROM WIN_RATE_2006, WIN_RATE_2005

question: Calculate the difference between the number of shipments shipped by the truck with the model year 2005 and model year 2006.

question: What is the average number of shipments done by the Kenworth trucks?

question: How many shipments does each driver deliver per month on average?

}

query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.ARREST = '1' THEN T2.REPORT_NO END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T2.REPORT_NO) FROM CHICAGO_CRIME.COMMUNITY_AREA  T1 INNER JOIN CHICAGO_CRIME.CRIME  T2 ON T2.COMMUNITY_AREA_NO = T1.COMMUNITY_AREA_NO WHERE T1.COMMUNITY_AREA_NAME = 'West Pullman' AND T2.DOMESTIC = 'TRUE'

question: Calculate the percentage of the domestic violence cases handled by Christopher Taliaferro. Among them, list report numbers of cases that happened in the bank.

question: What is the percentage of under $500 thefts among all cases that happened in West Englewood?

question: Calculate the difference in the average number of vehicular hijackings and aggravated vehicular hijackings in the districts.
evidence: "VEHICULAR HIJACKING" and "AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HIJACKING" are both secondary_description; difference in average = Subtract (Divide(Count(secondary_description = 'VEHICULAR HIJACKING'), Count(district_name)), Divide(Count(secondary_description = "AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HIJACKING"), Count(district_name)))
query:
SELECT ROUND(
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T1.IUCR_NO END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T3.DISTRICT_NAME END) AS FLOAT), 0)
  - CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T1.IUCR_NO END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T3.DISTRICT_NAME END) AS FLOAT), 0), 4) AS "DIFFERENCE"
FROM  CHICAGO_CRIME.IUCR T1
INNER JOIN  CHICAGO_CRIME.CRIME T2 ON T2.IUCR_NO = T1.IUCR_NO
INNER JOIN  CHICAGO_CRIME.DISTRICT T3 ON T3.DISTRICT_NO = T2.DISTRICT_NO
SQL:
SELECT ROUND(
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T1.IUCR_NO END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T3.DISTRICT_NAME END) AS FLOAT), 0)
  - CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T1.IUCR_NO END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION = 'AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HIJACKING' THEN T3.DISTRICT_NAME END) AS FLOAT), 0), 4) AS "DIFFERENCE"
FROM  CHICAGO_CRIME.IUCR T1
INNER JOIN  CHICAGO_CRIME.CRIME T2 ON T2.IUCR_NO = T1.IUCR_NO
INNER JOIN  CHICAGO_CRIME.DISTRICT T3 ON T3.DISTRICT_NO = T2.DISTRICT_NO

question: Which region has the highest number of games sold on all platforms?
evidence: which region refers to region_name; highest number of games sold on all platforms refers to MAX(SUM(num_sales));
query:
SELECT T.REGION_NAME
FROM (
  SELECT T2.REGION_NAME, SUM(T1.NUM_SALES) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM  VIDEO_GAMES.REGION_SALES T1
  INNER JOIN  VIDEO_GAMES.REGION T2 ON T1.REGION_ID = T2.ID
  INNER JOIN  VIDEO_GAMES.GAME_PLATFORM T3 ON T1.GAME_PLATFORM_ID = T3.ID
  INNER JOIN  VIDEO_GAMES.PLATFORM T4 ON T3.PLATFORM_ID = T4.ID
  GROUP BY T2.REGION_NAME
  ORDER BY SUM(T1.NUM_SALES) DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
) T
SQL:
SELECT T.REGION_NAME
FROM (
  SELECT T2.REGION_NAME, SUM(T1.NUM_SALES) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM  VIDEO_GAMES.REGION_SALES T1
  INNER JOIN  VIDEO_GAMES.REGION T2 ON T1.REGION_ID = T2.ID
  INNER JOIN  VIDEO_GAMES.GAME_PLATFORM T3 ON T1.GAME_PLATFORM_ID = T3.ID
  INNER JOIN  VIDEO_GAMES.PLATFORM T4 ON T3.PLATFORM_ID = T4.ID
  GROUP BY T2.REGION_NAME
  ORDER BY SUM(T1.NUM_SALES) DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
) T

question: Calculate the monthly average salary of the employee with highest salary. Mention his name, position title and location city.
evidence: highest salary refers to MAX(salary); name = firstname, lastname; calculation = DIVIDE(MAX(salary), 12)
query: SELECT SUM(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(T1.SALARY, 4), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) / 12 AS AVG, T1.FIRSTNAME, T1.LASTNAME, T2.POSITIONTITLE, T3.LOCATIONCITY FROM HUMAN_RESOURCES.EMPLOYEE T1 INNER JOIN HUMAN_RESOURCES.POSITION T2 ON T1.POSITIONID = T2.POSITIONID INNER JOIN HUMAN_RESOURCES.LOCATION T3 ON T1.LOCATIONID = T3.LOCATIONID WHERE CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(T1.SALARY, 4), ',', '') AS FLOAT) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(SALARY, 4), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) FROM HUMAN_RESOURCES.EMPLOYEE) GROUP BY T1.FIRSTNAME, T1.LASTNAME, T2.POSITIONTITLE, T3.LOCATIONCITY
SQL: SELECT SUM(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(T1.SALARY, 4), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) / 12 AS AVG, T1.FIRSTNAME, T1.LASTNAME, T2.POSITIONTITLE, T3.LOCATIONCITY FROM HUMAN_RESOURCES.EMPLOYEE T1 INNER JOIN HUMAN_RESOURCES.POSITION T2 ON T1.POSITIONID = T2.POSITIONID INNER JOIN HUMAN_RESOURCES.LOCATION T3 ON T1.LOCATIONID = T3.LOCATIONID WHERE CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(T1.SALARY, 4), ',', '') AS FLOAT) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(SALARY, 4), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) FROM HUMAN_RESOURCES.EMPLOYEE) GROUP BY T1.FIRSTNAME, T1.LASTNAME, T2.POSITIONTITLE, T3.LOCATIONCITY

question: How many female representatives served in the state of California for at least 10 years?
evidence: female refers to gender_bio = 'F'; representatives refers to type = 'rep'; served for at least 10 years refers to SUBTRACT(SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', end)), CAST(strftime('%Y', start)))) > 10;
query: SELECT SUM(T3.RESULT) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T2.END IS NOT null AND T2."START" IS NOT null THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(T2.END, 1, 4)) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(T2."START", 1, 4)) ELSE 0 END) > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RESULT FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE WHERE T1.GENDER_BIO = 'F' AND T2.STATE = 'CA' AND T2.TYPE = 'REP') T3
SQL: SELECT SUM(T3.RESULT) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T2.END IS NOT null AND T2."START" IS NOT null THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(T2.END, 1, 4)) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(T2."START", 1, 4)) ELSE 0 END) > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RESULT FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE WHERE T1.GENDER_BIO = 'F' AND T2.STATE = 'CA' AND T2.TYPE = 'REP') T3

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'sen' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'rep' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM LEGISLATOR.HISTORICAL T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.HISTORICAL_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE WHERE T1.GENDER_BIO = 'F' AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T1.BIRTHDAY_BIO, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY')) BETWEEN 1930 AND 1970
SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'sen' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2."TYPE" = 'rep' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM LEGISLATOR.HISTORICAL T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.HISTORICAL_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE WHERE T1.GENDER_BIO = 'F' AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T1.BIRTHDAY_BIO, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY')) BETWEEN 1930 AND 1970

query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.BIOGUIDE_ID) FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE WHERE T1.BIRTHDAY_BIO >= TO_DATE('1960-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T2.BIOGUIDE IN (SELECT BIOGUIDE FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS GROUP BY BIOGUIDE HAVING COUNT(BIOGUIDE) > 6)
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.BIOGUIDE_ID) FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE WHERE T1.BIRTHDAY_BIO >= TO_DATE('1960-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T2.BIOGUIDE IN (SELECT BIOGUIDE FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS GROUP BY BIOGUIDE HAVING COUNT(BIOGUIDE) > 6)

question: Among all the current legislators who have served for more than 4 terms, what is the percentage of them being female?
evidence: have served for more than 4 years refers to count(bioguide) > 4; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(gender_bio = 'F'), count(bioguide)), 100.0); female refers to gender_bio = 'F'
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_BIO = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT T1.GENDER_BIO FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE GROUP BY T1.GENDER_BIO, T1.BIOGUIDE_ID HAVING COUNT(T2.BIOGUIDE) > 4 )
SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_BIO = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT T1.GENDER_BIO FROM LEGISLATOR.CURRENT T1 INNER JOIN LEGISLATOR.CURRENT_TERMS T2 ON T1.BIOGUIDE_ID = T2.BIOGUIDE GROUP BY T1.GENDER_BIO, T1.BIOGUIDE_ID HAVING COUNT(T2.BIOGUIDE) > 4 )

question: Name the project that costs the most. How much has been collected from donation and what is the percentage amount still lacking?
evidence: project name refers to title; costs the most refers to max(total_price_excluding_optional_support); amount collected from donation refers to sum(donation_to_project); percentage amount refers to divide(subtract(total_price_excluding_optional_support, sum(donation_to_project)), sum(donation_to_project))*100%

query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.SCHOOL_METRO = 'RURAL' THEN T1.DONATION_TO_PROJECT ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(DONATION_TO_PROJECT) FROM DONOR.DONATIONS  T1 INNER JOIN DONOR.PROJECTS  T2 ON T1.PROJECTID = T2.PROJECTID
SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.SCHOOL_METRO = 'RURAL' THEN T1.DONATION_TO_PROJECT ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(DONATION_TO_PROJECT) FROM DONOR.DONATIONS  T1 INNER JOIN DONOR.PROJECTS  T2 ON T1.PROJECTID = T2.PROJECTID

question: What percentage of donations are given via a giving or campaign page? List the primary area of those donations.
evidence: given via a giving or campaign page refers to via_giving_page = 't'; percentage refers to DIVIDE(count(case when via_giving_page = 't' then donationid else null end),count(donationid))*100; primary area of donation refers to primary_focus_area
query:
WITH PERCENTAGE_CTE AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VIA_GIVING_PAGE = 't' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.DONATION_TOTAL) AS PERCENTAGE
  FROM DONOR.DONATIONS T1
),
PRIMARY_FOCUS_CTE AS (
  SELECT T2.PRIMARY_FOCUS_AREA AS PRIMARY_FOCUS_AREA
  FROM DONOR.DONATIONS D
  INNER JOIN DONOR.PROJECTS T2 ON D.PROJECTID = T2.PROJECTID
  WHERE D.VIA_GIVING_PAGE = 't'
  GROUP BY T2.PRIMARY_FOCUS_AREA
  ORDER BY SUM(D.DONATION_TOTAL) DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
)
SELECT P.PERCENTAGE, F.PRIMARY_FOCUS_AREA
FROM PERCENTAGE_CTE P
CROSS JOIN PRIMARY_FOCUS_CTE F

  FROM DONOR.DONATIONS T1
),

question: Which summer Olympic have the highest and lowest number of participants?
evidence: the highest number of participants refers to MAX(COUNT(person_id)); the lowest number of participants refers to MIN(COUNT(person_id)); Which summer Olympic refers to games_name where season = 'Summer';
query: SELECT (SELECT T1.GAMES_NAME FROM OLYMPICS.GAMES T1 INNER JOIN OLYMPICS.GAMES_COMPETITOR T2 ON T1.ID = T2.GAMES_ID WHERE T1.SEASON = 'Summer' GROUP BY T1.GAMES_YEAR, T1.GAMES_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T2.PERSON_ID) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS HIGHEST, (SELECT T1.GAMES_NAME FROM OLYMPICS.GAMES T1 INNER JOIN OLYMPICS.GAMES_COMPETITOR T2 ON T1.ID = T2.GAMES_ID WHERE T1.SEASON = 'Summer' GROUP BY T1.GAMES_YEAR, T1.GAMES_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T2.PERSON_ID) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS LOWEST FROM DUAL
SQL: SELECT (SELECT T1.GAMES_NAME FROM OLYMPICS.GAMES T1 INNER JOIN OLYMPICS.GAMES_COMPETITOR T2 ON T1.ID = T2.GAMES_ID WHERE T1.SEASON = 'Summer' GROUP BY T1.GAMES_YEAR, T1.GAMES_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T2.PERSON_ID) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS HIGHEST, (SELECT T1.GAMES_NAME FROM OLYMPICS.GAMES T1 INNER JOIN OLYMPICS.GAMES_COMPETITOR T2 ON T1.ID = T2.GAMES_ID WHERE T1.SEASON = 'Summer' GROUP BY T1.GAMES_YEAR, T1.GAMES_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T2.PERSON_ID) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS LOWEST FROM DUAL

question: What is the ratio of customer to subscriber that making a trip inside Mountain View city?

question: What is the percentage of the trip were done by a subscriber?
evidence: subscription_type = 'Subscriber'; DIVIDE(COUNT(id where subscription_type = 'Subscriber'), COUNT(id)) as percentage;
query:
SELECT (NUM_SUBSCRIBER * 100.0 / NULLIF(TOTAL_TRIPS, 0)) AS PERCENTAGE
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE = 'Subscriber' THEN 1 END) AS NUM_SUBSCRIBER,
         COUNT(SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
  FROM BIKE_SHARE_1.TRIP
)
SQL:
SELECT (NUM_SUBSCRIBER * 100.0 / NULLIF(TOTAL_TRIPS, 0)) AS PERCENTAGE
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE = 'Subscriber' THEN 1 END) AS NUM_SUBSCRIBER,
         COUNT(SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
  FROM BIKE_SHARE_1.TRIP
)

question: Among students registered for the most difficult course, list the students' full names who got grade A.

question: Calculate the GPA of the semester for Laughton Antonio.
evidence: GPA of the semester = DIVIDE(SUM(MULTIPLY(credit, grade)), SUM(credit)); grade 'A' refers to gpa = 4; grade 'B' refers to gpa = 3; grade 'C' refers to gpa = 2; grade 'D' refers to gpa = 1;

query: SELECT SUM(CASE T1.GENDER WHEN 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE T1.GENDER WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PER FROM TALKINGDATA.GENDER_AGE T1 INNER JOIN TALKINGDATA.PHONE_BRAND_DEVICE_MODEL2 T2 ON T1.DEVICE_ID = T2.DEVICE_ID WHERE T2.PHONE_BRAND = 'vivo'

question: Among the LG brand users, calculate the percentage of the Nexus 5 model user. What is the ratio of male and female users of it?
evidence: LG brand refers to phone_brand = 'LG'; percentage = DIVIDE(MULTIPLY(CONCAT(COUNT(device_id WHERE device_model = 'Nexus 5'), 100), COUNT(device_id)),'%'); ratio = DIVIDE(COUNT(device_id WHERE device_model = 'Nexus 5' AND gender = 'M'), COUNT(device_id WHERE device_model = 'Nexus 5' AND gender = 'F')); Nexus 5 model refers to device_model = 'Nexus 5';
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DEVICE_MODEL = 'Nexus 5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(T1.DEVICE_ID) AS PER, SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DEVICE_MODEL = 'Nexus 5' AND T2.GENDER = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DEVICE_MODEL = 'Nexus 5' AND T2.GENDER = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS R FROM TALKINGDATA.PHONE_BRAND_DEVICE_MODEL2 T1 INNER JOIN TALKINGDATA.GENDER_AGE T2 ON T2.DEVICE_ID = T1.DEVICE_ID WHERE T1.PHONE_BRAND = 'LG'

question: What is the percentage of all the trains with at least 4 cars? List the directions of the said trains.
evidence: at least 4 cars refers to trailPosi > = 4; calculation = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(count(trailPosi > = 4 then id), count(id)), 100)

question: Among the movies released from 1991 to 2000, calculate the percentage of comedy movies. Provide any five movie titles and directors.
evidence: DIVIDE(COUNT(movie_title where genre = 'Comedy'), COUNT(movie_title)) as percentage where substr(release_date, length(release_date) - 3, length(release_date)) between '1991' and '2000';
query: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.GENRE = 'Comedy' THEN T1.MOVIE_TITLE END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / nullIF(COUNT(T1.MOVIE_TITLE), 0)) AS PERCENTAGE_COMEDY, LISTAGG(T1.MOVIE_TITLE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T1.MOVIE_TITLE) AS MOVIE_TITLES, LISTAGG(T2.DIRECTOR, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T2.DIRECTOR) AS DIRECTORS FROM DISNEY.MOVIES_TOTAL_GROSS T1 INNER JOIN DISNEY.DIRECTOR T2 ON T1.MOVIE_TITLE = T2.NAME WHERE SUBSTR(T1.RELEASE_DATE, -4) BETWEEN '1991' AND '2000'
SQL: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.GENRE = 'Comedy' THEN T1.MOVIE_TITLE END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / nullIF(COUNT(T1.MOVIE_TITLE), 0)) AS PERCENTAGE_COMEDY, LISTAGG(T1.MOVIE_TITLE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T1.MOVIE_TITLE) AS MOVIE_TITLES, LISTAGG(T2.DIRECTOR, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T2.DIRECTOR) AS DIRECTORS FROM DISNEY.MOVIES_TOTAL_GROSS T1 INNER JOIN DISNEY.DIRECTOR T2 ON T1.MOVIE_TITLE = T2.NAME WHERE SUBSTR(T1.RELEASE_DATE, -4) BETWEEN '1991' AND '2000'

question: Among the movies released from 2001 to 2005, list down the titles and directors of the movies which had a total gross of more than 100% above the average.
evidence: Released from 2001 to 2005 refers to substr(release_date, length(release_date) - 3, length(release_date)) between '2001' and '2005'; DIVIDE(SUM(total_gross), COUNT(movie_title));
query:
SELECT T2.NAME, T2.DIRECTOR
FROM DISNEY.MOVIES_TOTAL_GROSS T1
INNER JOIN DISNEY.DIRECTOR T2 ON T1.MOVIE_TITLE = T2.NAME
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.RELEASE_DATE, LENGTH(T1.RELEASE_DATE) - 3, 4) BETWEEN '2001' AND '2005'
  AND ((TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM T1.TOTAL_GROSS), ',', '')) /
       (SELECT SUM(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM T3.TOTAL_GROSS), ',', ''))) / COUNT(T3.MOVIE_TITLE)
        FROM DISNEY.MOVIES_TOTAL_GROSS T3
        INNER JOIN DISNEY.DIRECTOR T4 ON T3.MOVIE_TITLE = T4.NAME
        WHERE SUBSTR(T3.RELEASE_DATE, LENGTH(T3.RELEASE_DATE) - 3, 4) BETWEEN '2001' AND '2005'
       )) - 1) > 1
GROUP BY T2.NAME, T2.DIRECTOR
SQL:
SELECT T2.NAME, T2.DIRECTOR
FROM DISNEY.MOVIES_TOTAL_GROSS T1
INNER JOIN DISNEY.DIRECTOR T2 ON T1.MOVIE_TITLE = T2.NAME
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.RELEASE_DATE, LENGTH(T1.RELEASE_DATE) - 3, 4) BETWEEN '2001' AND '2005'
  AND ((TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM T1.TOTAL_GROSS), ',', '')) /
       (SELECT SUM(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM T3.TOTAL_GROSS), ',', ''))) / COUNT(T3.MOVIE_TITLE)
        FROM DISNEY.MOVIES_TOTAL_GROSS T3
        INNER JOIN DISNEY.DIRECTOR T4 ON T3.MOVIE_TITLE = T4.NAME
        WHERE SUBSTR(T3.RELEASE_DATE, LENGTH(T3.RELEASE_DATE) - 3, 4) BETWEEN '2001' AND '2005'
       )) - 1) > 1
GROUP BY T2.NAME, T2.DIRECTOR

query: SELECT T1.ORGAN, CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS null THEN 'female' ELSE 'male' END AS GENDER, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM STUDENT_LOAN.ENLIST T1 LEFT JOIN STUDENT_LOAN.MALE T2 ON T2.NAME = T1.NAME GROUP BY T1.ORGAN, CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS null THEN 'female' ELSE 'male' END

question: What is the percentage difference between the attendence of disabled and non-disable students? Do the disable students show better attendance than non-disable students?
evidence: difference = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUBTRACT(COUNT(longest_absense_from_school.name that is in disabled.name), COUNT(longest _absense_from_school.name that is NOT in disabled.name), longest _absense_from_school.name), 100)); IF COUNT(longest_absense_from_school.name that is in disabled.name) < COUNT(longest _absense_from_school.name that is NOT in disabled.name), it means, the disabled students have better attendance than non-disabled students; IF COUNT(longest_absense_from_school.name that is in disabled.name) > COUNT(longest _absense_from_school.name that is NOT in disabled.name), it means the disabled students do not have a better attendance than non-disabled students;
query:
SELECT PERCENTAGE_DIFFERENCE,
       CASE WHEN AGGREGATE_VALUE > 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS ISHIGH
FROM (
  SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NOT NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
               SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.NAME) AS PERCENTAGE_DIFFERENCE,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NOT NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS AGGREGATE_VALUE
  FROM STUDENT_LOAN.LONGEST_ABSENSE_FROM_SCHOOL T1
  LEFT JOIN STUDENT_LOAN.DISABLED T2 ON T2.NAME = T1.NAME
)
SQL:
SELECT PERCENTAGE_DIFFERENCE,
       CASE WHEN AGGREGATE_VALUE > 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS ISHIGH
FROM (
  SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NOT NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
               SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.NAME) AS PERCENTAGE_DIFFERENCE,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NOT NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN T2.NAME IS NULL AND T1.MONTH = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS AGGREGATE_VALUE
  FROM STUDENT_LOAN.LONGEST_ABSENSE_FROM_SCHOOL T1
  LEFT JOIN STUDENT_LOAN.DISABLED T2 ON T2.NAME = T1.NAME
)

question: Among the flights of the air carrier described as American Airlines, what is the percentage of the flights with earlier departure?

query: SELECT T1.ID, T1.TITLE, T1.YEAR, T3.FULLNAME FROM AUTHORS.PAPER T1 INNER JOIN AUTHORS.PAPERAUTHOR T2 ON T1.ID = T2.PAPERID INNER JOIN AUTHORS.JOURNAL T3 ON T1.JOURNALID = T3.ID GROUP BY T1.ID, T1.TITLE, T1.YEAR, T3.FULLNAME ORDER BY COUNT(T2.AUTHORID) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

question: Which dish lasted longer, Anchovies or Fresh lobsters in every style?
evidence: if (SUBTRACT(last_appeared, first_appeared) WHERE name = 'Anchovies') > (SUBTRACT(last_appeared, first_appeared) WHERE name = 'Fresh lobsters in every style'), it means 'Anchovies' lasted longer; if (SUBTRACT(last_appeared , first_appeared) WHERE name = 'Fresh lobsters in every style') > (SUBTRACT(last_appeared , first_appeared) WHERE name = 'Anchovies') it means 'Fresh lobsters in every style' last longer;
query: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN NAME = 'ANCHOVIES' THEN LAST_APPEARED - FIRST_APPEARED ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NAME = 'FRESH LOBSTERS IN EVERY STYLE' THEN LAST_APPEARED - FIRST_APPEARED ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'ANCHOVIES' ELSE 'FRESH LOBSTERS IN EVERY STYLE' END FROM MENU.DISH WHERE NAME IN ('FRESH LOBSTERS IN EVERY STYLE', 'ANCHOVIES')
SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN NAME = 'ANCHOVIES' THEN LAST_APPEARED - FIRST_APPEARED ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NAME = 'FRESH LOBSTERS IN EVERY STYLE' THEN LAST_APPEARED - FIRST_APPEARED ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'ANCHOVIES' ELSE 'FRESH LOBSTERS IN EVERY STYLE' END FROM MENU.DISH WHERE NAME IN ('FRESH LOBSTERS IN EVERY STYLE', 'ANCHOVIES')

question: How many percent of Bluefish dishes are located at the center of the menu page?
evidence: percent = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(xpos BETWEEN 0.25 AND 0.75 and ypos BETWEEN 0.25 AND 0.75), COUNT(id)), 1.0); Bluefish is a sub name of dish; located at the center of the menu page refers to xpos BETWEEN 0.25 AND 0.75 and ypos BETWEEN 0.25 AND 0.75;
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.XPOS BETWEEN 0.25 AND 0.75 AND T2.YPOS BETWEEN 0.25 AND 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T2.ID) FROM MENU.DISH  T1 INNER JOIN MENU.MENUITEM  T2 ON T1.ID = T2.DISH_ID WHERE T1.NAME LIKE '%BLuefish%'
